summary: No blocking source defect found in the two M8 wrappers. source_findings.finding: Training passes builder=build, update=step and the three explicit variants to the original main. The verifier replaces the parent module globals that its main actually resolves, so it executes the original complete native contract with M8 callbacks. Both routes exclude demo_shared; the builder requires freeze_identity_encoder == 1. The inherited parser still lists freeze 0/1, but a 0 call is rejected before anchor construction.

The unchanged public_update reads full output[1][:,5120:] and partial query[:,5120:] from the actual fused 5632D metric descriptor. Each uses the existing shared_neck/shared_classifier with label-smoothed CE on official training IDs. Added weight is 0.05 full plus 0.05 partial. Original weighted full losses and the M4 relation/alignment/modality loss sum remain present; original partial 0.25 CE plus 0.5 stopped-full-gallery triplet remains present. No additional model/backbone forward is introduced.

source_findings.topic: Frozen identity anchor and initial coordinates
source_findings.finding: The exact original builder loads the full-official shared-DeMo selected best, maps its existing projection keys, and zeroes the extra query. BACKBONE, RGB/NIR/TIR reductions, generalFusion and shared_projection are requires_grad=False and recursively eval after train(). Their full state tensors, including buffers, are snapshotted and compared exactly after native update/reload and during training. Native validation retains all seven initial 00-versus-reference descriptor equalities and train-surroundings/eval-surroundings equality on the same eight-query fixture. These are runtime checks still awaiting M8 execution.

source_findings.topic: Native gradients, actual optimizer replay and strict reload
source_findings.finding: The original verifier constructs Adam from every trainable parameter, performs an actual unscaled update with GradScaler512, requires finite nonzero gradients for each optimizer tensor, replays the same unscaled gradients from cloned initial parameters, and checks its original allclose tolerance. It retains strict state-dict reload and exact before/after descriptors plus frozen state checks. The original three-actual-update smoke and final strict best-checkpoint reload are preserved. Source inspection does not attest their numerical success.

public_identity_weight=0.1 is put on args before run/native metadata are written, and on the model used by the existing update. Per-batch/native/smoke detail contains original and total losses, both public CE terms, actual weight, labels, descriptor slice, head source, two extra head calls, zero extra parameters/backbone passes, stopped reference, optimizer update result and names. The wrapper records freeze true, added_losses=1 and anchor initialization.

source_findings.topic: Same sampling, budget and official records
source_findings.finding: The main, original P16/K4 B64 identity sampler, all six uniformly drawn proper subsets, epoch seed schedule, Adam/scheduler, AMP initial scale512, and 50 additional epochs are reused verbatim. The new CE calls add no sampling RNG operation. The builder requires the full official manifest to equal the original anchor manifest; full_records uses the entire official training source and official query/gallery, with zero artificial holdout. Expected MSVR counts are 1032/591/1055 and expected zero-skip budget is 705 actual updates from the unchanged M7 sampler. M8 actual counts, names/order, coverage and 705 successful updates remain results to verify; 705 is not a hardcoded promise and all eligible records does not mean an exhaustive pass in every P/K-sampled epoch.

source_findings.topic: Model parameters and unchanged inference builder
source_findings.finding: M8 constructs the exact M7 AnchoredAxis and adds only a Python scalar training attribute; no modules, trainable parameters or state-dict keys are added. The M7 frozen49 and streamed-state entrypoints can use the original anchor builder and strict-load the M8 state because forward inference does not read public_identity_weight and returns descriptors/states before classification heads. Their existing full11/saved-array equality, full49 installed-GT evaluation, state version checks and raw receipt protocol remain unchanged. Actual M8 inference parity has not yet been run.

Evaluation compares distances to official labels with same-ID/same-scene MSVR or same-ID/same-camera RGBNT exclusions. Checkpoint selection is maximum full official benchmark mAP across50 with earliest ties and strict reload, explicitly benchmark-selected. Expected follow-up cases are 3x49=147 frozen and 3x49x6=882 state cases. Neither native gates nor single-seed MSVR can establish the unified three-dataset +2 objective.

non_blocking_findings.topic: One-factor wording includes mutable shared-head effects
non_blocking_findings.finding: M7 calls shared_neck once per full/partial training pair through base_supervision. M8 calls it three times: original raw shared feature, full fused public slice, partial fused public slice. shared_neck is outside the six frozen modules, so running_mean, running_var and num_batches_tracked change in addition to changed head/expert gradients. The plan and method text disclose two added head/BN calls. One-factor is supportable as enabling the exact existing public-CE training procedure, including these state effects; it cannot mean all model buffers are unchanged or isolate an abstract loss scalar from head updates. Those head buffers are saved but are not consumed by the deployed descriptor forward.

non_blocking_findings.topic: Future preflight intake must enforce the declared M8 gate
non_blocking_findings.finding: The reused native verifier records the public terms but does not separately assert every M8-specific intake condition. The reused smoke permits skipped attempts before reaching three successful updates and reports their count. Therefore a future source-reviewed preflight controller/intake must require zero skips, positive finite public_full_ce/public_partial_ce, weight0.1, two extra head calls, zero extra parameters/backbone passes, and exact M7 total/effective counts plus active gradient names. A generic parent PASS/SMOKE_PASS label alone is insufficient. This is acknowledged remaining pipeline work, not a newly found defect in the callbacks.

non_blocking_findings.topic: 705 updates and full-run success remain empirical
non_blocking_findings.finding: The unchanged source records actual updates, skips and visit coverage instead of forcing705. Source reuse supports the expected matching budget; future full-run intake must verify the actual successful-update count, full data manifest/coverage, identical M7 sampling orders and full strict reload. No M8 neural evidence exists in this review.
